name: 94024 · Los Altos, CA
findings: ZIP 94024 (Los Altos) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94024 (Los Altos) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 38 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
